create_ava_dataset: create a LabeledVideoDataset for the AVA actions dataset from frame paths and labels CSV files
parse_ava_frame_paths_and_labels: parse AVA dataset frame paths and labels CSV files into a list of labeled video paths tuples
load_ava_labels_csv: load and parse an AVA per frame labels CSV file into a nested dictionary of bounding boxes and labels
load_ava_image_lists: load image paths from an AVA frame paths file and return sorted absolute paths with video index mappings
sample_clip_at_timestamp: sample a video clip centered around a specific timestamp using a TimeStampClipSampler
